name: Emilio Ruth
source:
"Nyahaha, Everybody's going to owe me one now~"

Just a normal member of the crew of pirates.
He has a personality like a fickle cat and absolutely wont do things he isn't interested in.
He possesses strangely sharp intuition and is good at gambling and card games.
He respects [url=/c42784]Jake[/url] and [url=/c42785]Crave[/url] for taking him in, but his favorite thing to do is still to tease Jake.
